description: Normalize student application entry around /student/new-application while preserving compatibility aliases, valid programme/application deep links, selector-first behavior, direct Apply links, and query parameters.
steps: Update App.tsx and StudentNewApplication.tsx so the canonical route and compatibility aliases share one coordinator, missing/invalid IDs render the selector, and only validated deep links render StudentApplicationWizard.

Update StudentApplications.tsx and all inspected student Apply/Continue links to use the canonical path without losing universityId, programmeId, applicationId, or intake; preserve public intake behavior.
Add route/query unit coverage if a helper is introduced and extend tests/e2e/student-workflow.spec.ts for selector, aliases, valid/invalid deep links, and direct Apply behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Navigating to /student/new-application without IDs shows the country → university → campus → programme → intake selector.
Valid programme/application IDs open the wizard; invalid or absent IDs do not silently fall back to the first programme.
Compatibility aliases and Continue Draft links preserve their intended destination and query parameters.
verification: npm run test:unit -- src/utils/studentApplicationRoutes.test.ts (when the helper exists)
npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting followed by live route checks
